subject: Five Phoenix accounts to review for KEEPERS Commercial Cleaning
initial_email:
Hi KEEPERS Commercial Cleaning team,

Hey, this is Brett with BMC Service Network. We research local commercial accounts so service businesses can spend less time building lists and more time having useful conversations.

Your Phoenix page describes office, warehouse and hospitality cleaning.

I put together five Phoenix businesses to review against that scope. For example, Agave Home Loans has a published local contact route; the brief explains the facility fit and who to ask about vendor onboarding. Each entry includes its business website and a suggested first conversation.

You can keep the five free, as a PDF and an online brief. If the fit is useful, $499 buys 100 total, including those five. These are researched prospects—not businesses that requested a quote—and sales are not guaranteed.
